_meta.description: Research interests and experience timeline. Interests feed the Research page; experiences populate the detailed narrative cards.

fields.experiences: Array of { title, period, role, advisor, funding, summary, bullets, tags }

interests.title: Continual Learning
interests.description: Swiftly adapting foundation models to diverse, fast-moving domains without losing their general capability.

interests.title: Personal Models
interests.description: Alignment with inherent human preferences beyond verifiable rewards — models that genuinely fit individuals.

interests.title: Foundation Language Models
interests.description: My Ph.D. concentration: examining LLMs through a linguistic lens, from language ability to latent space.

interests.title: AI for Humanities
interests.description: Computational methods for heritage science, paleography, legal language, and stylistic evaluation.

experiences.title: Digital Humanities × Foundation Models at PKUDH
experiences.summary: Research at the PKU & ByteDance Digital Humanities Open Lab, Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Peking University, on multi-modal intelligence for cultural heritage, now continuing through my Ph.D.
bullets: Position paper towards computational Chinese paleography, mapping the end-to-end pipeline from data-scarce ancient materials to scholarship-grade outputs.
CLASE: a hybrid, reference-free framework for Chinese stylistic evaluation that combines interpretable linguistic features with experience-guided LLM-as-a-judge scoring, tested on legal Chinese.

experiences.title: Foundation Models for Heritage Science at Qwen Team
experiences.summary: Visiting algorithm engineer with the Qwen Team, Alibaba Group, exploring foundation-model approaches for heritage science.
bullets: Explored multimodal foundation models for cultural-heritage applications, building on the collaboration between Qwen and PKUDH.

experiences.title: AI for Humanities & Social Science at TsinghuaNLP
experiences.summary: Research intern in the Legal AI subdivision of TsinghuaNLP, infusing linguistics into LLM research and evaluation.
bullets: Built multi-agent court scenario simulation with LLM-powered agent roles.
Evaluated LLMs' proficiency on legalese; published PanelTR on zero-shot table reasoning through multi-agent discussion (IJCNN 2025).

interests.title: 持续学习
interests.description: 让基础模型快速适配多样且不断演化的垂直领域，同时不损失通用能力。

interests.title: 个人模型
interests.description: 超越可验证奖励、对齐人类内在偏好——让模型真正适配每一个个体。

interests.title: 基础语言模型
interests.description: 博士主攻方向：以语言学视角审视大语言模型，从语言能力到潜空间。

interests.title: 面向人文学的 AI
interests.description: 面向文化遗产科学、古文字学、法律语言与风格评测的计算方法。

experiences.title: PKUDH：数字人文 × 基础模型
experiences.summary: 在北京大学人工智能学院北大·字节跳动数字人文开放实验室（PKUDH）从事文化遗产多模态智能研究，并将随博士阶段继续深入。
bullets: 发表计算中国古文字学立场论文，梳理从稀缺、残损的古代材料到学术级产出的端到端方法管线。
提出 CLASE：面向中文风格评测的混合式无参考框架，将可解释语言学特征与经验引导的 LLM 评分结合，以法律中文为测试床。

experiences.title: Qwen Team：面向文化遗产科学的基础模型
experiences.summary: 于阿里巴巴通义千问团队（Qwen Team）担任访问算法工程师，探索面向文化遗产科学的基础模型方案。
bullets: 基于 Qwen 与 PKUDH 的合作，探索多模态基础模型在文化遗产场景中的应用。

experiences.title: TsinghuaNLP：面向人文与社会科学的 AI
experiences.summary: 于清华大学 TsinghuaNLP 法律 AI 方向研究实习，将语言学引入大模型研究与评测。
bullets: 构建基于 LLM 智能体角色的多智能体法庭场景模拟。
评估大模型的法律语言能力；发表 PanelTR（多智能体讨论实现零样本表格推理，IJCNN 2025）。
